title: Ilangatye Elatyhila Ilifa
intro: Kwiingxelo zembali zokuchasana, kumi umntu ogama lakhe laba sisilumkiso kude kube sekupheleni kwexesha. Lo mntu wakhetha ubutshaba kunolwalamano, ukungathobeli kunokuzithoba, waza wema ngokuchasene nobizo lwenceba. Mamela ngononophelo amazwi esibhengezo samandulo njengoko sityhila ubuwena balo mphefumlo udumileyo.
clues: Ndazalelwa kwisizwe esinye nesithunywa sokugqibela sika-Allah, kodwa ndandibachasa kuzo zonke iindlela.
Igama lam lalithetha intsingiselo—igama elithetha ‘uyise welangatye,’ igama elaliza kubonisa ikamva lam laphakade.
Ndabangela umonakalo kumphathi wenyaniso, kwanentsapho yam yajoyina eli phulo lenkohlakalo.
Ndisebenzise ubutyebi bam kunye nempembelelo yam ukuze ndithule ubizo oluya ku-Allah, ndikholelwa ukuba imali inokucima ukukhanya kobuthixo.
UAllah undinike isahluko esipheleleyo—isahluko esifutshane kangangokuba sinokufundwa ngemizuzwana, kodwa ubunzima baso buhlala bukho kude kube yiMini yoMgwebo.
Umlingane wam kwiLizwe Elizayo uhamba emva kwam, ebotshelelwe ngentambo yefayibha entanyeni, ephethe kanye ameva awayewasasaza.

outcome.label: Uvavanyo lokugqibela
